svg.title: Squadrone process flow: source review, clean-state proof, and disclosure drafts
svg.desc: Runtime verification is experimental, with validation and hardening in progress. A scan loads its configuration and compatible resume artifacts, obtains the plugin, builds a deterministic inventory and Surveyor threat map, and reviews checkpointed specialist batches. Citation verification, Critic review, and deterministic quality checks select candidates, retain manual or rejected outcomes, and merge duplicates. Disclosure scope applies only in the default mode; ranking and candidate caps apply in every mode. Triage-only stops before runtime verification. Each selected candidate is tested in isolated WordPress with legitimate setup, a snapshot, attack and negative control. A passing oracle must reproduce with the same script after restoring the snapshot. Failed attempts may iterate within their allowance, but only confirmed effects create findings. Verify-only stops before deduplication and reporting. Default scans deduplicate findings, then calculate report-stage CVSS and apply evidence and disclosure gates before drafting eligible reports. Exhausted source reviews remain explicitly unreviewed. Fatal errors preserve partial artifacts rather than proving safety or creating a finding.

g.text: Source review, runtime verification and private report drafts.
Resume compatible artifacts; retain cumulative cost.
Fetch or load the inspected plugin version.
Map handlers, sinks, controls and related workflows.
Fresh context; read source; link candidates to coverage.
Checkpoint completed work and explicit remaining gaps.

g.aria-label: Checkpoint and incomplete coverage retry note
g.text: A transport failure fails the stage.
A ledger does not prove coverage.

g.aria-label: Citation verifier, Critic and deterministic quality gates
g.text: Check source anchors, evidence, role and version scope.
Accept, merge, reject or retain for manual review.
Acceptance selects a candidate; it does not prove a bug.

g.aria-label: Disclosure scope, ranking and candidate cap
g.text: Program scope: default mode only. Rank / cap: all modes.
All proof steps in this frame remain

g.aria-label: Isolated sandbox, legitimate setup and PoC authoring
g.text: Author a bounded PoC; do not seed the exploit in setup.
Validate the family's trusted oracle and actor boundary.

g.aria-label: Clean-state restore and unchanged confirmation replay
g.text: Require clean-state confirmation, not an altered script.
No finding; not a safety verdict.
Unsafe setup or a broken reset
Persist reproduced effects; retain any narrower proof limits.
Default mode only; annotate known and related findings.

g.aria-label: Report evidence, scoring, scope and eligible private drafts
g.text: After dedup: grade evidence and calculate confirmed CVSS.
Write eligible private drafts; skip duplicates / ineligible items.
Completion does not prove complete coverage or exploitability.
Mode stops, review gaps and exhausted retries remain visible. Only clean-state proof produces confirmed findings.
